balls.text: plucked a one-hander with his left hand after having misjudged it. Smith has run it too far at long-off when he realises the ball is sailing over him, and then he goes in the air, over his shoulder and plucks this out with the left hand
low full toss, driven to wide of long-on for two
slower ball, on off, nudged away for one
Nayar's innings ends too. Gets a half-volley outside off, but can;t get under it, and drives this straight to Harbhajan at long-off
wide length ball, driven to sweeper-cover for one
wide full ball, dragged to midwicket for one
short, but not that slow. Pulled away on the bounce to deep square leg
slower bouncer, Nayar waits and waits and is still early into the pull
full and wide, edged away to third man where Ojha's misfield allows them the second
yorker, middle and leg, keeps this out, takes a single
full toss, on off, scooped over square leg
full, swinging, yorker. It's sliding down leg, but has hit him on the boot too
short of a length, angling in, drops and runs, takes the single
breaks the maiden with a clip to midwicket for one
on a length, on off, defended off the front foot
slower bouncer. Richardson is early into the shot and is cramped for room, and ends up lobbing it to long-on for a single catch
another slower ball. The left-arm bowler's offcutter. Short of a length, on off, leaves him a little. Squares him up. Misses the off stump by a coat of varnish
slower ball first up, and Richardson is days early into the slog
full and straight, driven back at him, takes a stump at the non-striker's end out. They get just the single
yorker, swinging down the leg side, dug out for just a single
low full toss, dipping on him, hits the toe of the bat
slower ball, nudged off the pads for one
full and outside off, dug out back to him
short of a length, outside off, mis-hit agonisingly over extra cover
into the pads, concedes a leg-bye
down the wicket to drive this down the ground
how expensive is this drop? Hit straight back at him chest high, but Maxwell lets it drop
driven wide of long-off for two
flighted on off, driven to long-off for one
short of a length, nudged away into the leg side for one
short of a length, taken from outside, clipped away over midwicket
short of a length, on off, angles across to beat his outside edge
short of a length, just outside off, defended off the back foot
full, outside off, defended
Nayar moves across the stumps to work this to leg
on a length, on off, defended off the front foot

Singh is King. Harbhajan. Not Yuvraj. Harbhajan is capping off a good spell excellently. He has been changing his pace well, and this one is pushed in slightly. Lands on a length, outside off, holds its line against the angle, beats the outside edge, hits him on the back pad. In front of off. Gone

stop the press. Tendulkar has hit a direct hit. And he has a wicket. The doosra from Harbhajan, he has dabbed it to short third man, and takes off for one. Tendulkar lets it rip, and takes out the middle of middle at the non-striker's end. This was a no-ball, but not called. Mathews would still have been out even if it was called a no-ball, by the way
stays round the stumps. Tossed up on off, defended back to him
bunted into the off side for one

he has found Rayudu as if he was his long-lost best friend. Full toss, knee high, middle and leg. He could have launched it anywhere, but has timed it straight to deep midwicket. They are checking it for a no-ball on height, but it is knee high only. Praveen Kumar must be wondering what the hell is this. They refused to check a chest-high no-ball for him when he could have won them a match. I am being told you can check for no-balls only if a wicket has fallen. Clear signs you need better people on the technical committee
low full toss. Yuvraj doesn't try to get under it. Is happy with just the singles off Malinga
slower ball, stays full still. Dug out to third man for one
low full toss, driven to long-off for one
full and straight, driven wide of long-on
full and wide, dug out past short cover for one
short of a length, back-cuts it, but can't beat point
doosra. Starts outside leg, bunted to leg for one
looks to pull but the ball isn't short enough. Gets a single off the mis-hit
cut away for a single to deep point
pushed away for a single into the leg side
fired into the pads, pushed into the leg side with soft hands, and they take on Ryaudu's arm. The throw is wide, and they make the second
flat, on off, pushed to short cover
clipped off the toes for one
Yuvraj has premeditated another slog-sweep, which is why he fails to make use of a full toss outside off. Gets an inside edge onto the pad
the giant is waking from his slumber. Another slog-sweep, another six over deep midwicket
full, middle and leg, and this time Yuvraj pulls out the slog-sweep to take the run rate past six an over. Over deep midwicket it goes
short, on off, punched down to long-off for one
slows it down now, 88ks, flighted on off, gets some turn away. Yuvraj defends respectfully
toppie again, punched down to long-on for one
a bit of drift, turning away from just outside off. They drop and run, and complete the single just in time
quick ball, short, pulled down the ground for one
slightly short of a length, dabbed to short third man for one
short of a length, angling in, defended back to him
flighted, middle and off, pushed back to Yuvraj
angled across him, pushed to the left of short third for a single
full and straight, middle and leg, dug out
flat, short of a length, defended back to him
off the inside half of the bat this goes for one
flighted on off, driven with an open face. Takes on the fielder in the deep and risks the second. Smith's throw is wide and on the half-volley
topspinner, middle and leg, worked to short fine leg
quicker, flatter, looks to cut it, can't beat backward point. Malinga, however, turns a tricky single into an easy one
nicely bowled. Slower in the air, drifts in towards off, lands on a length, then breaks away. Yuvraj shows it the respect and defends
fired in quicker, goes on with the arm again, hits the inside half of the bat
the topspinner. Pandey plays for the offbreak, the ball slides across, beats the outside edge, but Karthik fails to collect it, and allows the bye
short of a length, outside off, punched into the off side
full, outside leg, guided to short fine leg for one
pushed past midwicket for one this time
slog-sweep is out. Deep into the stands. Length ball, middle and leg, he opens up the body, gets on a knee, and sends it sailing over deep midwicket
clipped away off the toes for one
pushed into the leg side
starts with a slow slow delivery. Defended in front of off
pushed to mid-on for one
chipped over mid-off for four

on a length, into the pads, pushed to short midwicket. Yuvraj, the non-striker, is standing almost beside midwicket, and the fielder there is his good friend Harbhajan. A lot of play-acting follows. Yuvraj pretends to beat him up with the bat, and Harbhajan pretends to be hurt
slower ball, pushed on the up, but straight to cover
tries the pull off a ball that is not short enough, but somehow manages to clear mid-on
on a length, on off, defended to cover
slower ball, middle and off, defended from the crease
what a shot. This is nearly a yorker, on middle and leg, he is looking to save his toes, but has offered his bat in front, and somehow timed it supremely. Between mid-on and midwicket it goes
he hasn't overstepped this time. Uthappa misses another full toss. He has moved too far across to play this to leg. The ball is swinging in, and his him on the full, and in front of middle. Gone
goes deep into the crease for the free hit, turns this into a half-volley, and drives it square for four
hit on the pad by a full toss, and just when Malinga looks around to appeal, he sees the outstretched right arm of the umpire. It's a no-ball too
short, rising towards the head, he has pulled after taking his eyes off it. Manages to somehow keep it down, though
full, outside off, played with an open face to third man
on a length, outside off, driven with an open face, to cover-point
length ball angling in, worked away into the leg side for one
chips a length ball over mid-on and comes back for two
full outside off, driven nicely, but straight to mid-off
cut away to third man for one
full, on off, defended off the front foot
rises high towards the chest from short of a length. Pandey dabs it to the left of point to get off the mark
Johnson strikes early once again. Just short of a length, Finch wants to drive, the ball comes on slowly, and he ends up hitting it straight to short cover
short of a length, on the pads, lucky he doesn't get the bat on it because Malinga is up at short fine leg. Malinga's throw is wide, and Maxwell gets his first touch on the ball
swings in from just short of a length, defended in front of middle and leg
on a length, slight shape back in, defended off the back foot
length ball, on off, dabbed away past slip for one
lucky runs. Finch drives hard at one in front of off, gets a thick inside edge, and the fine leg is way too square to field this
pushed back at him, Nechim gets a hand on it in the follow-through
this one doesn't swing. It's on a length, middle and leg, and he plays the pick-up shot over midwicket
full, straight, swinging towards middle and off. Inside edge onto the pad
punched away nicely to the right of cover-point, a dive and a half-stop keeps them down to two
pushed straight to mid-on, and the pick on Tendulkar and take the single
swinging in this t9me, headed towards the top of off. Defended off the front foot. Good over
dug in short of a length, rising towards the chest. No room either. Finch has to fend
on a length, middle and leg, pushed to the right of Sharma at short midwicket. Sharma is not at his sharpest, allows them the single
this one doesn't swing, but bounces off a short of a length. Left alone outside off
fullish, swinging in, defended in front of middle and leg
full outside off, slight swing in, beats his tentative push
wide length ball, he rocks back and smashes it over cover for four. Harbhajan does a bit of a Bhangnam again. Mumbai Indians go to No. 2 on the table
quick full ball, it goes between Harbhajan's leg. Will these dots this over eventually be the difference between second and third spot?
length ball, outside off, defended to cover
wide half-volley, Sharma drives, gets a thick edge, and it is taken by a leaping Dinda at short third man. Sharma is livid, but he has done his job
full toss, hit straight to mid-on
slower short ball again, pulled away for one again
slower length ball. Maxwell adjusts well, gets a single to point
slower short ball, one too many, and he makes room and pulls this over deep midwicket for six. Mumbai within striking distance now
makes room to drive a full ball, but hits it straight to mid-off
slower bouncer. Beats the pull and hits him in the chest
that was a good bouncer. At 139ks. Maxwell is clearly late into the pull, and it goes off the glove to fine leg for four
googly, but too full. No time for turn. Driven to long-on for one
punched to long-on for one
past the diving Dinda. He leans back to dab on this flat ball, Dinda puts the dive in, but doesn't get to it. It wasn't that well timed. he vould have chased after it and kept them down to two
short of a length, middle and leg, pushed to the straightish short midwicket
this one moves in a little, hits the inside half of the defensive bat. What are the chances Sharma just sees off this over?
pushed off the front foot, past cover

Dinda keeps them in. Rayudu hasn't seen them through. Rayudu moves across the line to try to pull this over short fine leg, but the ball doesn't quite come on, and he ends up pulling it straight to deep backward square leg
driven to deep cover for one
slower ball wide yorker. Beats his attempt to drive it
wide half-volley, driven straight to extra cover, but Nayar overthrows to allow them a single
he stays back to a full ball, and clips this past midwicket. That's an audacious shot
and he starts this spell as poorly as the start of the first spell was good. Short and wide, cut away through point for four
flat, shortish, pushed between cover and extra cover for one
flighted outside off, driven to short extra cover
fired in, worked away for one
slow, really slow, punched to deep cover for one
into the seats behind the sight screen. Down the wicket, not to the pitch of it, but goes ahead with the loft, and makes a clean connection
pushed past the diving Yuvraj for a single to long-off
length ball, wide, pushed past point for one
big wide down the leg side
driven wide of long-off for two
slower short ball, down the leg side, mis-hits the pull, fine of short fine, but Dinda puts in a big dive there to save three runs
full, outside off, driven straight to mid-off
length ball, outside off, defended with an open face
full, middle and leg, pushed to mid-on for one
driven to long-off for one. The asking rate has crossed six by the way
drives well, but straight to straight extra cover
defended to short midwicket
slow through the air, defended off the front foot. And Pune concede an overthrow
on a length, driven on the up, to sweeper-cover
moves forward, drops this slightly to the right of cover-point, and takes a single
dabs on this late, gets a single to third man for one
short of a length, outside off, pushed with soft hands for a single to cover
cut away uppishly to third man for one
late-cuts this to third man for one
slower ball, defended off the front foot
is that the game? Draws the edge as Sharma pushes away from the body, but there is no slip in place. Sharma gets four for it
flat again, on a length, defended back to him
flighted outside off, driven to long-on
short and flat again, worked away for another single
punched down to long-on for one
short, outside off, punched away to long-off
full, middle and leg, clipped away
defended off the front foot
full, middle and leg, driven to long-on for one
gets the short ball that can be cut for four, but ends up edging it to short third man
punched away uppishly, past the diving backward point. Gets four for it
full, on off, driven back to Yuvraj
tossed up outside off. Teasing delivery. Left alone
carrom ball, doesn't turn much, driven to long-on for one
quick, straight, seems a googly. Defended off the back foot
pushed past point for one
angling into the pads, nicely nudged away
overpitched again, driven to long-on for one
too full, driven to long-off for one
another forward-defensive to end the over
flighted on off, pushed back to Yuvraj
driven to deep cover for one
tossed up on off, defended off the front foot
Mumbai are making a mess of this chase. This is tossed up wide, Karthik wants to slog-sweep it, and ends up slicing it to long-off
bowls a nice little full toss, but Sharma gets just a single to long-on
carrom ball, just outside off, defended off the front foot
defended to short cover
that's a wide down the leg side, but it is not given because Karthik was looking to play the reverse-sweep. Good call
googly again. Karthik well forward in defence
pushed to mid-off for one
googly, turns in from middle and off, beats the inside edge
another punch on the up, but finds the fielder with this one
short of a length, wide, punched away on the up, between cover-point and cover. The run rate crosses six now
short of a length, holds its line, defended in front of off
defended to leg off the front foot
is that an edge or the meat? He has clearly top-edged this pull, Dinda is setting under it at fine leg, but this has cleared him comfortably
short of a length, outside off, played with an open face
on a length, outside off, defended to cover-point
short of a length, no turn, defended back off the front foot
full, into the pads, clipped away for one

the long-on is back, and Tendulkar has obliged him. Carrom ball, on off, doesn't turn much. It seems Tendulkar is trying to chip it back over Mendis's head, but the ball hasn't turned and he ends up closing the face a little. A sitter for long-on
shortish, into the pads, worked away for one
on a length, straight, defended off the front foot
nicely played. Gets inside the line of a short ball again, and pulls this between the keeper and short fine leg. Along the ground
short of a length, outside off, defended off the front foot
defended off the front foot again
defended off the front foot
short of a length, wide again, beaten on the drive. Extra bounce there
short, wide, rolls his wrists on the cut, places it to the right of third man. Gets a couple
a bit of a hoick, doesn't get all of it, but it is a safe shot because he cleared the infield easily
good outswinger again. Again headed towards off, and Tendulkar just defends
gets inside the line of a bouncer, it has bounced more than he expects and hits his glove, but still flies clear of the keeper for four
short of a length, outside off, punched away to short cover
good outswinger, ending up in front of off. Defended with a slightly closing face
drives hard, gets a thick edge, gets a single to third man
slower ball, has Tendulkar groping outside off, beats the outside edge
short and wide outside off. Tendulkar goes for the cut. Called wide for height
short of a length, into the pads, pushed into the leg side for one
short of a length, outside off, punched to cover
short of a length, outside off, pushed to point with an open face
wide down the leg side. Uthappa gets a hand to it
wide length ball, left alone
down the wicket to push this to cover-point
pushes at a wide length ball, gets a thick edge past slip
short of a length, angling in, he has glanced it nicely fine of fine leg. Bhuvneshwar is a bit like catching a chicken at the fence, but has eventually done well
dug in short, head high, pulled away for one
on a length, on off, angling in, defended back to him
another good outswinger, Karthik is forward to cover it. Defends

Dinda has taken the off stump first ball. What a beauty first ball. Just short of that driving length, on off, and then swings away against the angle. Smith has played the line, but has lost his off stump. It hits top of off
